description_en: Generates an access token for an application in a specified IDaaS instance based on credential information
description_zh: 使用凭证信息，生成指定IDaaS EIAM实例下某个应用的access token
kebab_example: aliyun eiam-developerapi generate-token --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --grant-type client_credentials --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateToken

parameters.help_en: The client secret. This parameter is required when \`grant\_type\` is \`client\_credentials\` and the \`client\_secret\_post\` method is used
parameters.help_zh:
客户端密钥，赋值场景：
当grant_type为client_credentials"，采用client_secret_post方式时，需填写此值
parameters.name: client_secret

parameters.help_en:
The authorization grant type. The following types are supported:

\`client\_credentials\`: Client credentials grant. Requires \`client\_id\` and \`client\_secret\`.

\`refresh\_token\`: Refresh token grant.

\`authorization\_code\`: Authorization code grant.

\`urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device\_code\`: Device flow.

\`password\`: Password grant
parameters.help_zh:
授权类型，目前支持的类型如下：
client_credentials 客户端模式，需要传入client_id和client_secret
refresh_token 刷新令牌
authorization_code 授权码模式
urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code 设备流模式
password 帐密模式
parameters.name: grant_type

parameters.help_en: The authorization code. This parameter is required when \`grant\_type\` is \`authorization\_code\`
parameters.help_zh:
授权code码，传入场景：
grant_type=authorization_code 授权码模式时，必填参数
parameters.name: code

parameters.help_en: The username. This parameter is required for the password grant type
parameters.help_zh: 账户名，在帐密模式下，必填参数
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en: The username. This parameter is required for password mode
parameters.help_zh: 账户名，在帐密模式下，必填参数
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The device code. This parameter is required when \`grant\_type\` is \`urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device\_code\` (device flow)
parameters.help_zh:
设备code码，传入场景：
grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code即设备流模式时，必填参数
parameters.name: device_code

parameters.help_en: The redirection URI. This parameter is required for the authorization code grant type. It must match the redirection URI in the request to get the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
重定向URI，传入场景：
grant_type=authorization_code 授权码模式时，必须参数，与获取授权码请求中的重定向URI必须是一致的
parameters.name: redirect_uri

parameters.help_en: The refresh token. This parameter is required when \`grant\_type\` is \`refresh\_token\` (refresh token grant)
parameters.help_zh:
刷新token，传入场景：
grant_type=refresh_token即刷新令牌模式时，必填参数
parameters.name: refresh_token

parameters.help_en: The code verifier. This is used in the authorization code grant type when PKCE is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 授权码模式下，开启PKCE能力时，对应的验证code
parameters.name: code_verifier

parameters.help_en:
The scope. This parameter is optional. Multiple values are supported. Separate multiple values with spaces.
Valid values:

openid

email

phone

profile
parameters.help_zh:
scope范围，非必须，支持多选，多个取值以空格分隔。
可选取值：
openid 
email
phone
profile
parameters.name: scope

expires_at.description_en: The expiration time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
expires_at.description_zh: 失效时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为秒

expires_in.description_en: The validity period of the token in seconds

token_type.description_en:
The token type. Valid values:
Basic - Basic type
Bearer - Bearer type
token_type.description_zh:
token类型，取值可选范围：
Basic - Basic类型
Bearer - Bearer类型
